mentions.name: JSONPath101
mentions.description: A web-based tool for JSON query evaluation and debugging, offering an interactive editor for writing and testing JSONPath queries, inspired by the ease of use of regex101.
mentions.problem: Existing tools for writing JSONPath queries are not as nice or powerful to use, forcing manual crafting and testing of queries one at a time.
mentions.source_excerpt: The most recent project I’ve been working through has been a tool for JSON query evaluation and debugging [0] inspired by how easy regex101 is to use.
